selection.policy: All 11 A/C discordant rows, plus the lowest row index among both-correct cases for each gold label (1, 550, 1035), the lowest both-failed row for each available gold label (189, 1058), and the next-lowest remaining both-failed row (195).

metric_definition: Macro-F1 averages full-precision per-class F1 over gold-supported classes only (entailment and contradiction); neutral predictions are misclassifications.

condition_definitions.B_minimal: Reviewed minimal decisive evidence with necessary identity, attribution and conditions.
condition_definitions.C_minimal_plus_distractors: B followed by two reviewed non-decisive distractors; length-confounded contrast with B.
condition_definitions.D_reordered: Identical C with the complete B block after distractors; both internal orders preserved.

summary_reporting_caveat: Saved flat prompt_tokens_total/completion_tokens_total fields are incorrectly zero because usage is nested under result. Metrics here sum raw result.usage; saved token_latency totals agree. Original summaries and evaluation code were not changed.

Le Conseil fédéral préconise de rejeter l’initiative populaire « Pour une immigration modérée (Initiative de limitation) ».
